name: apache-ranger
description: Apache Ranger (minimum 2.8.0, target 2.9.0) as the access-policy and audit plane of the HKM open-source data platform: architecture and policy model (resource, tag, masking, row-filter, deny/exceptions, zones, roles), Kubernetes deployment without an official chart, identity sync with Keycloak/LDAP, RBAC+ABAC policy design for multi-institution tenancy and KVKK purpose limitation, engine plugins (Trino, Kafka/Strimzi, Spark via Kyuubi AuthZ) and native compilation for engines without plugins (ClickHouse, Superset, Nessie, CKAN), audit to OpenSearch/immudb, REST API and policy-as-code, operations and upgrades
